name: Mida Leasing Public Company Limited
summary: Mida Leasing Public Company Limited provides financial services for used cars hire-purchasing and management of non-performing assets in Thailand. The company, through its subsidiary, Mida Asset Management Company Limited, also engages in asset management from transferred non-performing asset of financial institutions. It also provides other financial services. As of December 31, 2019, it had 17 branches in Bangkok and other provinces. Mida Leasing Public Company Limited is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
